headline: From light lather to lightweight moisturizer

steps.label: Step 1 · Wash
steps.line: Light lather on a wet face, then rinse thoroughly

steps.label: Step 2 · Serum
steps.line: 2-3 drops; let the serum absorb fully

steps.label: Step 3 · Moisturizer
steps.line: Lightweight, oil-free; massage in until fully absorbed

footnote: 4.1 out of 5 stars from 899 reviews on beminimalist.co, captured 2026-10-02
layout_description: Three real pack shots across the middle, each linked by a thin connecting line, step label above and one short line below. Headline and subhead across the top. Footnote bottom, CTA bottom-right.
image_prompt: Empty background scene only: a pale off-white surface with a soft wide splash-like ripple pattern in very light blue only at the outer edges and gentle daylight. Off-white, soft natural light, few props, clinical minimal style. Square 1080x1080. Keep the middle 80% of the frame as an empty clear space, evenly lit and keep any props in the outer edges. No product, no bottle, no packaging, no text, no letters, no logos, no people, no faces, no skin, no hands.
adaptation_notes: Kept: water-splash scene (Foxtale), 'Step N' labels (Dot & Key), numbered-card ordering (Pilgrim). Reworded step names to avoid Pilgrim's Cleanse/Treat wording. Dropped: seasonal monsoon kicker, model, 'Glow' promises, swatches and handwritten checklist. Textures come from each product's own page facts.

blend_sources.took: Step 1 / Step 2 labels above each pack
numbered, connected-card ordering of three products

verdict.label: Ready for human review
verdict.detail: No blocking or must-fix issues found. This is a pre-screen, not an approval: brand and legal sign-off is still required.
